name: Sign-in & GitHub access
tagline: Landing page, sign-in and GitHub App access
summary: Visitors see a landing page with a clickable sample of the app, sign in with GitHub, then choose which accounts and repositories DiffKit may read by installing its GitHub App.

flow.label: Landing page
flow.note: /login shows the headline, a sign-in button and the sample preview; signed-in visitors are sent on.

flow.label: signInWithGitHub
flow.note: Forgets the last remembered viewer, then starts GitHub sign-in with a checked return path.

flow.label: Better Auth handler
flow.note: /api/auth/* completes the OAuth exchange with GitHub and sets the session cookie.

flow.label: D1 account rows
flow.note: One account row per token: provider 'github' for OAuth, 'github-app' for the App user token.

flow.label: Setup page
flow.note: /setup lists your account and each organisation as installed or not, with a link to fix it.

flow.label: App authorize and callback
flow.note: Authorize sets a state cookie and redirects to GitHub; callback checks it and saves the token.

features.name: Landing product preview
features.summary: The real topbar, lists, inbox and pull request page run on sample data. Links switch views inside the preview and nothing is fetched.

features.name: GitHub OAuth sign-in
features.summary: Better Auth's GitHub provider with repo, read:org and user:email scopes. In demo mode a generic OAuth plugin points it at the local emulator.

features.name: GitHub App setup
features.summary: A second authorization stores a refreshable App user token. /setup then lists each account as installed or not, with a link to fix it.

features.name: Two GitHub apps
features.summary: OAuth App: sign-in and fallback reads. GitHub App: installation tokens, webhooks and install discovery. Private repos outside the installs are hidden.

features.name: Optimistic auth
features.summary: A returning viewer's name and avatar come from a non-secret hint cookie, so the shell paints at once while the real session check runs behind it.

features.name: Access dialog
features.summary: Opened from warnings and error screens. It lists every account with its install status and links to GitHub to configure or authorize.

features.name: Safe redirects and sign-out
features.summary: Return paths are parsed so only same-site paths survive. Sign-out also wipes the hint cookie and the user's IndexedDB caches.
